location: §5.5 (EV target-state expectations), step 5 ARM, the Σ_add / P_pts lines (L662-663)
problem: Two problems, both from this round's 05 change to the ability_debuff_immune gate. (1) The text states P_pts without the gate that 05 now applies. (2) The gate clause on Σ_add sits after the whole sum, so it reads as zeroing Corrosive Projection and companion strips as well. Neither 05 nor 04 gates those. Current text: "Σ_add = ability strips·Str + Σ_CP 0.18·aura_str + T-07 + companion % strips (Sharpened Claws) (05 E-5.10;\n           0 for ability_debuff_immune = all); P_pts = Polarize 400·Str (05 9.3)". Read literally, an EV run against an Eidolon or an Archon keeps Polarize's 400·Str armor points and drops Corrosive Projection. 05 prescribes the opposite in both cases.
evidence: 05 E-5.10 as changed this round: "P_pts: Polarize 400·Str, 0 when ability_debuff_immune = all (13.1)". In E-5.10's Σ_add, only the ability-strip term and T-07 carry "0 when ability_debuff_immune = all"; Σ_CP and the companion % strips do not. 05 §13.1: "Entries from mods, arcanes, auras (Corrosive Projection, Shield Disruption), focus, companions and statuses are not gated by it". 04 §4.2 `ability_source` is false for auras and companions (Sharpened Claws). W:Eidolon_Teralyst L81: "Corrosive Projection is recommended to decrease the Teralyst's armor", so CP against Eidolons is a common build. 05 owns E-5.10 (00 §7.2), and 08 step 5 itself says "05 E-5.10 in full".
fix:
Replace the two lines with:
"        Σ_add = ability strips·Str + Σ_CP 0.18·aura_str + T-07 + companion % strips (Sharpened Claws) (05 E-5.10;
           the ability strips and T-07 are 0 for ability_debuff_immune = all, 05 13.1; Corrosive Projection and the
           companion strips are never gated); P_pts = Polarize 400·Str as 05 9.3 assigns it (shields first), 0 for
           ability_debuff_immune = all (05 9.3, 13.1)"
No id, input or toggle changes.

location: §9.3, the paragraph after the E-5.10 sources ("The ability strip list with percentages is `04`'s catalogue (§5.7: … Smite 100 %, Unairu Caustic Strike 100 %).", L890-894)
problem: 05 puts Unairu Caustic Strike in the "ability strip" list that feeds E-5.10's first Σ_add term. fix: Replace "Smite 100 %, Unairu Caustic Strike 100 %)." with "Smite 100 %; Unairu Caustic Strike 100 % enters the same Σ_add term with Str_j = 1 (focus, not Str-scaled) and, its `ability_source` being false (`04` §4.2), is not gated by 13.1).". E-5.10 is unchanged.
